svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Fig. 9 — One sphere and two: the 1s and 2p_z states of hydrogen
electron density in a plane through the axis, each scaled to its own peak; Kron's network gives both levels
2p_z: E = −1/8 Ha, two lobes, nodal plane z = 0
Russell's two spheres meeting at a central plane, with a point between them, have the shape of 2p_z: the electron is never on the plane z = 0.
